description: Generic Linglong packaging workflow pack for Linux repositories that already contain linglong.yaml or project-native Linglong build scripts
notes: This pack is generic and should be applied inside a target repository that already contains Linglong packaging inputs such as linglong.yaml or build-linglong.sh.
It is not a zero-to-one package authoring kit. It standardizes reset, rebuild, export, and validation for existing Linglong-capable projects.
After packaging, write a retrospective and run the retrospective check. If the check fails, the workflow is not complete.
